cg.pdf.header.title: Guide the conversation and listen actively
cg.pdf.header.intro: Start with the team’s overall survey results to build a shared understanding before exploring the focus areas.
cg.pdf.focus.title: Focus areas
cg.pdf.focus.intro: Share the focus areas with the team, then agree on one to explore together.
cg.pdf.strengths.title: Team strengths
cg.pdf.strengths.intro: Celebrate what's working well and explore how to sustain or build on it.
cg.pdf.share.title: Explore the results together
cg.pdf.share.body: Share the results on screen so everyone can see the same overview. Open your focus areas using the link, or scan the QR code to view them on your phone.
cg.pdf.share.qr_caption:
Scan to open
your focus areas
cg.pdf.agenda.title: The conversation (35 to 45 min)
cg.pdf.step1.title: Open the conversation
cg.pdf.step2.title: Look at the results as a whole
cg.pdf.step3.title: Take a moment to celebrate
cg.pdf.step4.title: Dive deeper, then agree on a next step
cg.pdf.step5.title: Close the meeting
cg.pdf.step1.body: Set the purpose: understand the experience behind the results before deciding what to do. Agree to listen, to understand, make room for different experiences, and discuss patterns rather than individual responses.
cg.pdf.step1.quote: “These results tell us where to look, not why they are what they are. I would like us to understand the experience behind them together.”
cg.pdf.step2.open_picture: Open the picture: What do you recognize? What stands out?
cg.pdf.step2.check_resonance: Check resonance: What feels incomplete or surprising? Which focus area should we explore together?
cg.pdf.step3.notice: Notice: What is helping this work well? When have you experienced this at its best?
cg.pdf.step3.build: Build: What should we protect, repeat or build on?
cg.pdf.step4.intro: For your chosen focus area, pick two or three questions below. Listen, ask follow-up questions, then summarize what you hear.
cg.pdf.step4.notice: Notice: What stands out to you about this result?
cg.pdf.step4.example: Example: What does this look like in our day to day work? Can you think of a recent example?
cg.pdf.step4.context: Context: What was happening when the survey was running?
cg.pdf.step4.driver: Driver: What seems to be making this easier or harder?
cg.pdf.step4.difference: Difference: Does anyone experience this differently? What might explain the difference?
cg.pdf.step4.influence: Influence: What part of this is within our team’s influence, and what needs support elsewhere?
cg.pdf.step4.meaningful_change: Meaningful change: What would make a meaningful difference?
cg.pdf.step4.keep_going_quotes: “Can you say a little more?” · “What else is important here?” · “I am hearing … Did I capture that accurately?”
cg.pdf.agree.title: What you agree together
cg.pdf.agree.sentence: Decide whether to {improve}, {monitor} or {need support}, then set one small step and name who owns it.
cg.pdf.step5.summary_quote: “Today we heard … We agreed to … The first step is … [name] will … by …”
cg.pdf.step5.takeaway_quote: “What is the most important thing we should take forward?”
cg.pdf.step5.thanks: Thank everyone, and make sure the agreement and the follow up moment are visible to the team afterwards.
